title: Unreal Agent
summary: Unreal Agent is an open-source AI agent framework developed by Unreal Labs that enables developers to build autonomous agents capable of performing complex multi-step tasks by integrating with large language models and providing ready-made tools and abstractions.
problem_solved: Simplifies the development of autonomous AI agents by providing a structured framework with built-in tools, memory management, and orchestration capabilities.
why_valuable: Reduces the barrier to entry for building AI agents, offering pre-built components and abstractions that developers can customize without building everything from scratch.
